verdict.rationale: Adyen Agentic is an agentic-commerce payments platform that handles checkout flows, product feeds, tokenization, an MCP server and webhooks. Merchant-side configuration management is a plausible capability for this kind of product, so the axis applies. However, the evidence never mentions versioning, reviewing, or rolling back automations or workflows. Session cancel/commit steps are checkout operations, not automation version control, so they earn no credit.
